title: Arbitrary base change for qcqs etale compact support
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring. Work in the bounded-below derived categories of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. For any separated finite-type morphism $h:T\to B$ of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], a compactification $c=(j:T\hookrightarrow\overline T,p:\overline T\to B)$ consists of a quasi-compact open immersion $j$ and a proper morphism $p$ with $h=pj$ [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification]; write $Rh_!^c=Rp_*j_!$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be such a morphism, let $g:Y'\to Y$ be any morphism with $Y'$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and form $X'=X\times_Y Y'$ with projections $g':X'\to X$ and $f':X'\to Y'$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. For a compactification $c$ of $f$, let $c'$ be its base change to $Y'$. Then for every $K\in D^+(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ there is a natural isomorphism $g^{-1}Rf_!^cK\cong Rf'_!^{c'}g'^{-1}K$, where inverse image of constant-coefficient module sheaves is applied termwise [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image].

proof.text: Use IsPullback.of_hasPullback f g for the literal fibre product. The compactification c.baseChange g is definitionally c.ofIsPullback for this square. The two squares are c.isPullback_g_ofIsPullback and c.isPullback_i_ofIsPullback; the construction supplies properness and the open immersion without reconstructing them. Unfolding rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlus identifies the compact-support functor with exact derived extension by zero followed by bounded-below derived proper pushforward.

proof.text: The finite ring is additively torsion by isAddTorsion_of_finite. Apply AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.isIso_baseChange_of_isProper_of_isAddTorsion_ring to the proper square (c.isPullback_g_ofIsPullback sq).flip. Take asIso of the resulting natural exchange transformation baseChange and whisker it on the left by the exact derived extension-by-zero functor. This uses the already stated module form of proper base change; no additional coefficient-forgetting lemma is necessary.

proof.text: Use extensionZeroBaseChangeDerivedPlusIso on c.isPullback_i_ofIsPullback sq, and whisker that natural isomorphism on the right by the derived direct image of the base-changed proper factor. Compose the proper and open natural isomorphisms with three functor associators to obtain the displayed isomorphism of compact-support functors. Wrap the constructed isomorphism in Nonempty. Naturality is intrinsic to the two natural isomorphisms and their whiskering and composition.
